title: Upper Lower Hypertrophy Split to Failure
author: Igor F.
desc: This Hypertrophy program is designed to maximize exercise variety while introducing calisthenics supersets to make sure that muscles are strained to failure or as close to failure as possible.

Set #2 is performed to at least 15 reps to close to Failure followed by a calisthenics superset to actual failure
